race.comment: HELLENIC BELLE (11) ended her juvenile prep with a fair run at stakes level, and she will be resuming in the right grade for her here. She won her latest of 2 trials, and has attracted JMac to the saddle, which is enough for us to put her on top. MOSCATEL (12) is a promising filly who won her juvenile debut by leading all the way, and then went for a spell after finishing sixth as the favourite in stakes class at Scone in May. She has had a couple of tune-up trials, and is ready to give this a big shake. AGATHA (5) has hit the line strongly in each of her 2 runs back from a spell, and if she can sort herself out at the start, then she can have the last say in this. SCREEN ICON (7) bolted in as expected when winning her maiden. Stick with her.
